message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice; files are received via HTTP upload and there is no checksum, signature, or integrity verification on the uploaded content.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples in the data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: The classifier is loaded via `clf.load_classifier_from_file(CFG['classifier']['timestamp'])` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in any of the provided code paths.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.
No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics implemented in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected output bounds checks: The predict_image function checks for None or integer error codes from the classifier but does not validate probability scores, check for NaN/Inf values, or enforce bounds on the model's raw output confidence values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-based face recognition system, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
